goal: In Android Settings, turn on Airplane mode and launch YouTube. If YouTube's notification permission prompt appears, choose Don't allow. Verify YouTube reaches its offline screen.
preconditions: Android Settings is open at its root screen.
The emulator has working mobile-data internet before the test; the test fixture enables mobile data and disables Wi-Fi and Airplane mode.
YouTube is installed on the device.
cleanup: Restore the original Wi-Fi, mobile-data, and Airplane-mode state captured by the test.
